output.summary: Widespread grass genus found across Europe, Africa, Asia, Australasia, the Pacific and the Americas. Some species are cereal or fodder millets, while others become troublesome farm weeds; early barnyard grass can resemble rice closely enough to escape weeding.
output.edibilityNote: Some species are cereal crops, including Japanese, Indian barnyard, burgu and channel millets; this does not apply to every species.
